title: [Cyrasei Lira'ka Apiary]
description: Sunbeams streak through breaks in the leafy canopy above, dancing across a red-streaked brown conical hive and a quadrate blue tanik beehouse as a gentle breeze wafts through the area.  From within the hives, a constant, harmonious buzz flows out to create a deep, peaceful thrum beneath the rustle of leaves.  Floral-carved windchimes hang from lower branches, blending smoothly with the hum from the colonies.
